title: Antispam Bee Review
description: A documented profile of Antispam Bee for filtering comment and trackback spam without CAPTCHAs.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped Antispam Bee WordPress plugin profile from KreativWP.
highlights: The official listing focuses on blocking comment and trackback spam
Its documented settings include comment-trust, language, country, and notification controls
The listing describes a free, ad-free product that does not send personal information to third parties
bestFor: Content sites that retain native WordPress comments and want a configurable anti-spam workflow without a CAPTCHA layer.
researchScope: This profile reviews Antispam Bee’s official WordPress.org listing. It does not test spam-detection accuracy, local privacy obligations, or integration with a custom comment system.
caveats: Spam controls can create false positives. Review the moderation policy, monitor early results, avoid deleting legitimate discussion automatically until verified, and document any location-based settings.
